lines.text: Many learners say: My home is near from the school.
Better: My home is near the school.
Near! The park is near my house.

data.wrong: My home is near from the school.
data.right: My home is near the school.

native.tip: 中文说“离学校很近”，“离”对应 from，所以很多人说 near from。英语里 near 后面直接接地点，只有 far 才用 far from。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “My home is near from the school.”😅 中文的“离”对应 from，但 near 后不加：“My home is near the school.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“My home is near the school.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Chinese uses a word like from with near, but English says near without from.
en.caption: Do you say “My home is near from the school.” 😅 English says near without from: “My home is near the school.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
